name: Wetterkreuzhütte
beschreibung: The Wetterkreuzhütte is located at about 1,400 metres above sea level in the Ötztal, surrounded by alpine meadows and mountain forests. The holiday home offers simple, alpine furnishings with wood panelling and a tiled stove. Guests reach the property via a mountain road that may require chains in winter. The drive to the Sölden ski area takes about 25 minutes. The hut is suitable for hikers and nature lovers seeking peace away from the main tourist centres.
